subtitle: Cartridge Control
reader_desc: Detect a game and save a ROM dump to shared storage.
systems_note: Detected cartridges appear automatically. If the system is unknown, select a reader directly in its slot.
files_desc: Browse, rename, move, download or delete ROM files in shared storage.
name: Name
writer_desc: This area is reserved for future flash and save operations, with explicit safety checks.
wifi_warning: Changing network settings may interrupt your connection.
time_note: Time and time zone are currently read-only. Language files can be added without changing the backend.
confirm_delete: Delete this file/folder? This cannot be undone.
confirm_disconnect: Disconnect Wi-Fi? Your browser may lose access.
slots_note: Presence is reported passively by the kernel. This does not identify the game system or adapter.
advanced_note: Only readers with confirmed read operations are selectable. Manual selection does not detect adapters or change voltage.
manual_reader_hint: No unique reader can be chosen for this slot. Select a reader manually in Advanced settings.
help_intro: Quick start guide for reading cartridges and managing ROMs. The full instructions are available online.
help_step_one: Connect Retrode3 to your computer and open its web page.
help_step_two: Insert a cartridge. The slot indicator shows physical presence.
help_step_three: Select a supported reader, detect the cartridge, then read the ROM.
help_step_four: Access completed dumps in the File Manager or via Samba.
help_web_desc: The full guide covers connections, supported systems, troubleshooting and limitations. It can later be moved to the public Wiki.
help_note: Only explicitly supported read-only operations are currently available. Do not remove cartridges during a read.
wifi_associated_no_ip: Associated with Wi-Fi but no IP address yet
wifi_legacy_warning: Wireless device detected, but the old connection helper cannot identify it. Connecting may not work yet.
wifi_helper_warning: Wireless device detected, but the connection helper did not respond. Check the WLAN helper.
wifi_not_found_detail: No wireless interface was found via /sys/class/net or iw dev.
wifi_scan_empty: No networks returned. Check wireless status and scan permissions.
core_intro: The central CLI reports installed cores, enabled state, compatibility and supported operations. A core may be enabled without being ready to read ROMs.
core_cli_missing: The central retrode3-cli was not found at the expected system path.
core_confirm_disable: Disable this core? It will no longer be available for new operations.
plugins_desc: View and manage installed cartridge readers. The CLI reports their activation and supported operations.
core_cli_not_executable: The central CLI exists but cannot be executed. Check permissions.
core_cli_error: CLI discovery failed. Check the backend log and CLI protocol.
generic_choice_required: Multiple read layouts are possible. Select a game or layout.
generic_unknown: Cartridge not identified. A supported manual override is required.
generic_optional_title: Multiple titles possible. Choosing one is optional when the safe layout is identical.
generic_unavailable: This read configuration is not approved.
generic_invalid: Choose a complete, supported read configuration.
generic_schema_error: CLI selection capabilities unavailable. Check core and CLI version.
verification_mismatch: ROM data differs from the selected database entry
verification_not_found: ROM read, but no unique database match
verification_ambiguous: ROM read, but identification remains ambiguous
verification_not_checked: ROM read; database verification was not performed
voltage_manual_required: Voltage must be checked/set manually before reading.
voltage_manual_detail: Voltage: currently {current}; {required} required for reading. Please verify manually.
voltage_manual_required_voltage: {required} required for reading. Please verify voltage manually.
voltage_manual_current_voltage: Voltage: currently {current}. Please verify manually before reading.
slot_manual_note: Manual selection does not verify an adapter or change voltage.
flash_intro: Choose the cartridge system explicitly. Only supported Flash devices may be written.
flash_select_hint: Select a system to inspect its flash capabilities.
flash_upload_pending: ROM upload and programming remain disabled until the Flash transport has been validated.
flash_probe_ready: Flash detection available. Insert your compatible flash cartridge and press Detect.
flash_unavailable: Flash detection is not available for this core yet.
flash_invalid_result: Flash probe returned an unexpected result.
flash_unidentified: No supported flash chip was identified. Writing is blocked.
flash_detected_locked: Flash chip identified. Programming remains disabled until full writer support is tested.
flash_detected_readonly: Flash chip identified. Writing is not supported on this cartridge.
